content.bridge_context: Building on basic shapes, we explore Symmetry—where one half of a shape is the mirror image of the other.

units.title: Line of Symmetry
units.explanation: An imaginary line that divides a shape into two identical halves.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the mirror line. / दर्पण रेखा की पहचान करें।

units.title: Symmetry in Nature & Art
units.explanation: Symmetry is found in butterflies, leaves, and monuments like the Taj Mahal.
units.dual_language_instruction: Find symmetry around you. / अपने आस-पास समरूपता खोजें।
